title: Adenosine for Hair Loss: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Adenosine for Hair Growth & Thinning: Trials & Evidence | FullyVital
seo_description: What randomized trials and a 2025 review show about topical adenosine for thinning hair, how much evidence there is, and what to expect.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.

Old post (2,229 words, 0 study links) ran on to history, 'current environment', alternatives and foods high in adenosine. Rewritten around the three strongest sources: two randomized trials in men and the 2025 meta-analysis.
flags: The closing FullyVital product box (unchanged, sitewide) says products 'Promote Hair Regrowth'. Left for you, as with boron.
The trials are on topical adenosine lotions in androgenetic alopecia (disease research, neutral). Check against your claims policy.
'These studies are of topical adenosine, not food or supplements' is a plain clarification from the abstracts. Your own products' adenosine form and use may differ.
Strongest hair evidence of the batch, but still graded low overall by the review; the article says so.
